definition: to knock an opponent to the ground
description: On a muddy rugby pitch under dark storm clouds, a young player in a striped muddy jersey with a long braid grabs an opponent round the hips and brings her crashing down into the mud as the ball flies loose. Both players slide through the puddles, then lie in the mud laughing and push themselves up onto their hands and knees while teammates run up. Spectators under umbrellas cheer on the touchline, and a referee in green runs towards them with one arm raised.
